acquisition_cost_note: Acquisition fractions are screening requests, not measured downstream diagnostic cost or recovery.

calibration.family_threshold_policy: Separate healthy-reference quantiles; no family-wise false-trigger guarantee
calibration.matched_wls_score: max(J/chi2_threshold, max_abs_normalized_residual/local_threshold); omit local term in chi-square-only mode
calibration.population_note: Empirical calibration only; independent parent-held-out testing is required. The WLS union has its own measured rate.
calibration.score_semantics: uncalibrated sigmoid scores; thresholds are empirical healthy-reference quantiles

wls_comparator.rule: J >= chi2 threshold OR max(abs(rN)) >= normalized residual threshold

invalid_screen_policy: unavailable, never a negative prediction; independent acquisition fallback remains required
network_transfer_claim: none; new parent IDs alone do not establish a different network
uncertainty_method: percentile bootstrap of physical parents, keeping every paired window together
